ModMetaData.name: RimSense
ModMetaData.author: Serhii Shramko
ModMetaData.description:
SteelSeries GG lighting for RimWorld.
Your SteelSeries RGB gear lights up only when the colony needs you: - Red: hostiles on a map with your colonists. - Amber: a colonist in trouble (serious mental break, bleeding out, giving birth) or a large fire. - Flashing means it just started; steady means it's still going. - Otherwise your own lighting is untouched.
Requires SteelSeries GG (Windows or macOS). Colors can be changed in GG: Engine → Apps → RimWorld → Configure.
